hypothesis.statement: Small disconnected foreground regions and thin accessories cannot be safely classified by component size, and indiscriminate cleanup can erase identity-relevant silhouette detail.
hypothesis.action: Measure connected components, define fixed complex-edge ROIs, render source/checker/alpha zoom boards and support checksummed add/remove/replace layers constrained to declared ROIs.
hypothesis.expectedResult: Every matte edit becomes attributable and reversible, while uncertain hair, finger, earring and shoelace decisions remain blocked for human review.

canonical03.finding: hair body is usable as a draft shape silhouette; some flyaways are thickened and the star earring is mostly omitted

canonical16.finding: body silhouette is usable as a draft; finger gaps and thin shoelace loops are simplified or disconnected

decision: Keep the drafts and correction format. For temporary body/face shape reconstruction, exclude accessory geometry by policy; reserve earring and shoelace fidelity for modular final assets rather than hallucinating it into the base mesh.
